title: feat: video and community model quests; retire three low-return quests
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds "Use a video model" and "Try a community model" (0.25 Quest Pollen each, Setup).
- Adds "Your community model gets used" (2 Quest Pollen, Grow) once others spend >0.5 Paid Pollen across the publisher's community models. Own calls, Quest Pollen and agents don't count.
- Retires three quests that pay out without moving revenue (Addresses #16008). Existing rewards stay visible and claimable:

| Quest | Why |
|---|---|
| Senior dev (1 P) | Pays for account age: 6.4k Pollen paid out, 41% never claimed, claimers convert at the first-API-key rate |
| Your app is gaining users (3 P) | 0 of 17 claimers paid within 30 days; "Paid Pollen is flowing" already rewards real use |
| Create an agent that gets used (2 P) | Agent use is mostly internal; can't be tied to paid use without a gen change |

- Extends `quest_model_modalities` / `quest_agent_usage`; no D1 or gen changes.
- Verified: quest tests 55/55, Biome. Tinybird staging deployment #175 is created (not promoted); pinned requests return the new columns. Both MVs rebuild from the last 3 months, so older unclaimed flags drop.

**Deploy order:** promote Tinybird staging, deploy production, then promote the Worker.

gist.headline: More paths through the garden
gist.blurb: Video models and community models get their own Quests. Publish a model that other people use, and there’s a Grow Quest for that too.
gist.summary: Adds 0.25-Pollen Setup Quests for using a video model and trying a community model, plus a 2-Pollen Grow Quest when others spend more than 0.5 Paid Pollen across a publisher’s community models; three older Quests retire while earned rewards remain claimable.
gist.impact: Video and community-model use gain new Quest rewards, and publishers can earn 2 Pollen from qualifying use by others; self-calls, agents, and Quest Pollen do not count toward that threshold.
gist.visual_concept: Depict the new Quest paths as a cozy garden: a video screen, a community-made model sprout, and a small Pollen reward growing when visiting bees use it. Polli tends the model sprout in a tiny gardener’s hat; keep the scene focused on sharing and growth rather than billing.
